headline: SDP @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.92 at BAL 4.55, with a projected total of 8.47. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: SDP moved -0.36 runs while BAL moved +0.50, changing the projected margin by -0.85 runs. NRFI probability dropped -6.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Walker Buehler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Alonso, Fernando Tatis Jr., Taylor Ward, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jase Bowen, Samuel Basallo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
